thread:
zoe: FWIW onboarding sampleapp failed when using JS SDK: server accepts curl but SDK returns 400 on route create. Found during quickstart run.

ben: can you paste payloads? Which SDK and quickstart template?

zoe: @ben using @redwood/js 2.3.1 and quickstart-chat template. SDK call: 
```js
await client.routes.create({
  name: 'welcome',
  model: 'redwood/gpt-3x',
  traffic_percentage: 50, // server expects snake_case
  enable_followups: true, // experimental flag
});
```
SDK error: 400 "unknown parameter: traffic_percentage". same body via curl works.

marcus: hmm our JS client by default converts keys to camelCase when serializing (we added that to match idiomatic JS), but server still expects snake_case. curl uses snake_case so it works. Also noticed SDK strips keys not in typings (enable_followups), so experimental opts get dropped.

lina: also saw duplicate routes created in Dedicated when CI hit a 401 mid-request. SDK auto-refreshes token and retries POST without idempotency header. curl doesn't retry so no duplicate.

ben: two separate DX regressions: param-name normalization + unknown-key filtering, and unsafe retry behavior for non-idempotent ops.

zoe: can we ship a short-term patch that preserves unknown keys and stops aggressive normalization? New users hit this in first 5 mins so high impact on onboarding.

marcus: proposed quick fixes: 1) add pass-through for unknown keys under an "_raw" field, 2) stop automatic camelCase conversion for top-level request bodies, 3) generate Idempotency-Key header for POST/PUT/PATCH if none provided. Longer term: update typings and docs.

lina: ops: i'll add a server-side tolerance for camelCase fallback for a few weeks to buy time.

devops-bot: Ticket created RDW-1339 - "js-sdk param normalization + unsafe retry causing onboarding failures" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1339 :white_check_mark:

ben: ok assigned. @marcus please open PR adding idempotency header generator and preserving unknown keys; add e2e in sampleapp CI that sends experimental flag to assert server saw it. @lina please coord server fallback window and we will rollback after SDK patch.

zoe: thanks — this was blocking a new customer demo. small changes but big DX impact. :thumbsup:
